prediction_text: The ship is LIVING — not sunk — though she has been in danger and has taken harm: Saturn in Aries in the 11th casting a square very near the Ascendant (the ship's body, shown by the ascending degrees of Cancer) speaks damage and peril, but the Moon, lady of the Ascendant, is in Taurus in her exaltation, strong, applying by trine to the Sun and Mercury in the 7th and near the body of Jupiter, which preserves her. She is abroad on the western/Spanish coast side (the applying planets placed in the 7th, the western angle; her voyage quarter shown by the 9th afflicted by the South Node — she has met foul dealing/weather on the voyage). Timing (day-scale): the Moon wants but a few minutes of the perfect trine — news of her will come very shortly, within a few days.
basis: tradition: horary（卡面载明）。systems_used: horary。已载面：船沉否（主问）、何地何海岸、消息何时至（题面续问）。断项过闸：船存←升主月亮擢升强旺入庙、入相三合七宫太阳水星且近木星；曾遇险受损←土星四分上升点（船体）；方位←入相诸星居西角七宫，取西向／西班牙海岸一带（粒度：仅一条方位指针，按区域粒度交付）；应期定日档（近事消息），月亮距成相仅数分，逢值路取数日内为主坐标，冲实／填实二路无候选已注明。对象核：承受对象=船（非人对象），应验同为船，未回收到船主身上。
